note: Act folders before the layout move (2026-11-13) were named by the act id (slug) at the top level; paths maps each id to its folder: <kind>/<year>/<number>, the kind the BWB gives the regulation, the year and number of its original publication (Staatsblad for laws and royal decrees, Staatscourant for the rest, prefixed stb-/stcrt-/trb- when it is the other gazette), a treaty by the year it was concluded and its Treaty database number; -<BWB id> where two acts share a publication number (a Staatscourant number before 2009 is a whole issue), the BWB id where none is known. Local regulations (local/) and case law are not moved.
